rows.criterion: Prove the change does what it claims. With every cache.clear() deliberately disabled, drive owner A -> sign out -> owner B ENTIRELY THROUGH THE APPS OWN UI WITHIN A SINGLE DOCUMENT - no page.goto(), no page.reload(), no context recreation at any point - and assert owner B receives none of owner A cached data. PAIRED POSITIVE CONTROL, SAME TEST, SAME SURFACE: with the resets still disabled and the keys reverted to owner-agnostic, owner B MUST receive owner A data. Without that control the experiment cannot show it was capable of observing the defect. ANCHOR THE EXPERIMENT ON THE [profile] QUERY: profile-editor.tsx:400 sets staleTime: Infinity, so it NEVER REFETCHES. The bleed is therefore PERSISTENT rather than a flash, which makes the assertion far harder to pass by accident and removes any argument that a race, not the cache, produced the result.
